standalone.scope: one cold child per format; independent package outside repository; no Python or TS loader

readerBenchmark.scope: Original Python JsonLogReader vs Node streaming reader over identical local gzip files. Includes decompression, exact JSON numeric boundary checks, message iteration and open/close; input construction excluded. Node strict EOF validation is additional. No target-board or concurrent-print proof.

checks: Node reader round trip retains integers beyond binary64 and small floating values
Full-flush indexed seek resumes at correct record
Standalone exports with independently installed dependencies and PATH=/no-programs
CLI listing, graph planning, explicit option errors and output preservation
limitations: No Matplotlib desktop window; HTML is the interactive output and -o is required
Remaining historical Python oracle tests and benchmarks are not retired
Offline local performance only; no target-board or concurrent-print claim
Default printer entrypoint remains Python and historical runtime/numerical failures remain open
